name: phoebephobia
source:
A story about a lonely girl having a bit of a rocky relationship with a girl in her dreams.

[From [url=https://bluehollow.itch.io/phoebephobia]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一個孤獨的女孩，與自己夢裡出現的另一個女孩相處得不太順利。這是關於她們的故事。

［摘自[url=https://bluehollow.itch.io/phoebephobia]itch.io[/url]］
